title: Learn Docker from Scratch
description: Master Docker within a month with this hands-on course. Learn how to containerize applications, manage Docker images and containers, and deploy efficiently across environments.

Syllabus.title: Introduction to Docker
Syllabus.description: Understand what Docker is and why it's useful for modern software development.

Syllabus.title: Installing Docker
Syllabus.description: Get Docker running on your machine.

Syllabus.title: Working with Docker Images
Syllabus.description: Learn how Docker images work and how to use them effectively.

Syllabus.title: Managing Containers
Syllabus.description: Create, start, stop, and manage Docker containers.

Syllabus.title: Dockerfile and Custom Images
Syllabus.description: Build your own Docker images using a Dockerfile.

Syllabus.title: Volumes and Data Persistence
Syllabus.description: Handle data that needs to persist across container restarts.

Syllabus.title: Networking in Docker
Syllabus.description: Connect your containers using Docker networking features.

Syllabus.title: Dockerizing Real Applications
Syllabus.description: Learn how to Dockerize real applications and run them in isolated environments.

Syllabus.title: Publishing and Sharing Images
Syllabus.description: Share your Docker images with others.
Lesson: Tagging and pushing to Docker Hub

Syllabus.title: Docker in Production
Syllabus.description: Understand how Docker is used in production environments.

Syllabus.title: Troubleshooting and Debugging
Syllabus.description: Learn how to debug issues and use Docker logs effectively.
